risk: Misleading retry or permission bypass messaging
negativeCase: 403/device-limit denial must not be presented as a harmless retry or successful pairing
evidenceNeeded: Offline UI state regression plus browser/OAuth denial acceptance

risk: Lost keyboard focus or clipped controls on narrow screens
negativeCase: 375px viewport and keyboard-only traversal must not hide focused actions
evidenceNeeded: Browser screenshot, focus path and assistive-technology check

risk: Admin panel falsely announces completion or stale status
negativeCase: Failed API response must not leave aria-busy true or announce success
evidenceNeeded: DOM fixture and authorized/denied admin browser acceptance

risk: Unsafe installation guidance or confusion between web and MCP URLs
negativeCase: Setup failure instructions must not ask for secrets or disable Windows security gates
evidenceNeeded: Docs smoke plus owner-approved clean Windows installation review

risk: Read-only MCP capability described as privileged CORE access
negativeCase: Public MCP listing must not imply unauthorized mutation or native authority
evidenceNeeded: Source/read-only contract comparison and owner security review
